description: Get one template's full spec: html, css, the variable manifest (with hard rules per variable), formats, palette tokens, embedded fonts, render_tech, plus what is `static` (the owner fixed it: logo, frame, signature, fixed texts; never move, cover or restyle it), what is `dynamic` (the variables you fill: the picture, the headline, the caption that is the post body), what it `suits` (news, photo, quote, number, tip, on_this_day, meme, any) and the owner's `instructions` (they override any general rule). Fill every dynamic {{variable}}, then render with headless Chrome at the chosen format's size and WAIT for [data-vh-ready='1'] before screenshotting .vh-card. With preview=true the answer is instead preview {document, html, css, format, variables}: a complete page with the example values (or `variables`) filled and the organization's design baked in, to open in a browser or render, so a template is seen before any post is made.

preview.description: true = how it looks: preview.document is a full HTML page with the example values filled (yours with `variables`).

variables.description: With preview: your own values, {"text": "…", "highlight": "…"}; the rest take the manifest examples.

name: viralhunt_get_template
